title: Pickleball Rocks
style: male vocals, uptempo, fun, double bass, a cappella, with sections in Spanish, a cappella, slow
lyrics:
[Intro]
[whispered vocals]
Ah dah dah dah
Pickleball rocks
Pickleball rocks

[Verse 1]
It's so fun and it's so easy
Everybody's playing now
Believe me
From the parks to the driveways
People picking up paddles every single day
Lawn balls are so last week
We out here in the sun having a good time
No stress
No fuss
Just you and me
And that little plastic ball flying free

[Chorus]
Pickleball rocks everywhere
I got rocks in my pockets
Rocks on the stairs
Because pickleball rocks everywhere
Me and my paddle
Pickle rocks
Pickle rocks
Pickleball rocks everywhere
Spreading across the land without a care
Me and my paddle
Pickle rocks
Pickle rocks
Ah dah dah dah

[Verse 2]
What's that sound? Sss sss what's that?
Ah
It's that pickleball rocks sound coming back
Dinking and driving
Laughing in the sun
Once you start playing
You can't get enough
It's taking over
It's everywhere you go
Young and old
Fast and slow
No big court needed
Just a little space
Pickleball rocks
Put a smile on your face

[Chorus]
[double bass
A cappella]
Pickleball rocks everywhere
I got rocks in my pockets
Rocks on the stairs
Because pickleball rocks everywhere
Me and my paddle
Pickle rocks
Pickle rocks
Pickleball rocks everywhere
Spreading across the land without a care
Me and my paddle
Pickle rocks
Pickle rocks
Ah dah dah dah

[Bridge]
Lawn balls are so last week
We still having fun in the sun
Pickleball rocks
Pickleball rocks
Yeah
It's taking over everyone
